long_biography.plain_text:
The family business began with a downtown Bangkok duty-free shop established by Vichai Srivaddhanaprabha in 1989. Aimon joined its leadership before succession became necessary: she was appointed group deputy chair and chief financial officer in 2004. The company grew into an airport-retail platform and later added hospitality, property and sports interests.

Following Vichai's death, the second generation took operating control. Aiyawatt became executive chairman, and Aimon moved into the family's senior governance role alongside children who hold other management posts. The Premier League's public register also lists her as a Leicester City director.
